title: Email send request v1
description: NEW. The approved artifact JobTrack emits to the Inbox send edge. v1 (FROZEN): the exact bytes to send are referenced by `content` as a `draft_artifact` digest (a reference to an already-persisted, content-addressed draft; no bytes inline). Inline `rendered_mime` is deferred to v2. Locks `recipient`, carries `inReplyTo`/`threadId`, an `idempotencyKey` (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes retry unable to double-send), and an embedded approval-receipt.v1. The Inbox edge re-verifies: approval.approvedArtifactDigest == content digest; recipient == approval.scope.recipient == the ingested thread's From/Reply-To; then sends exactly, never re-rendering.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable per-send key. The outbox lane dedupes on this; a retry with the same key cannot double-send.

recipient.description: Locked recipient. The edge asserts this equals approval.scope.recipient AND the ingested thread's From/Reply-To. Mismatch => fail closed.

content.description: v1 (FROZEN): draft-artifact digest reference only. The edge re-fetches the already-persisted, content-addressed draft and sends only bytes whose digest equals approval.approvedArtifactDigest. Inline `rendered_mime` is deferred to v2.

digest.description: Digest reference to an already-persisted, content-addressed draft artifact; MUST equal approval.approvedArtifactDigest. No bytes inline.
